summary: There were too few matching stores to judge this price. The listing shows ₹7,780 against an M.R.P. of ₹11,995 and claims 35% off.

voices.point: Users praise quick cooking, even results, and easy touch-screen use.
Several reviews say cleanup is easy and the nonstick tray helps.
One reviewer found the instructions too incomplete for basic cooking needs.
A common complaint is the basket can feel small for two people.
One review mentions a sharp inner basket catch during washing.
